propositions: The shell guard 'change predates the gate' appears 24 times across .github/ with copies drifting apart (missing guard in anxious-resistant-urson, late addition in sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly).

The guard cannot move to a shared repo file because shared owners are absent on pre-gate trees where the guard must execute; this breaks tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::test_mutation_selector_skips_pre_gate_trees_without_weakening_current_trees.

Four gate callers share ref resolution (gate_source.resolve_gate_handle) and three share flag resolution (gate_enabled), but code_review_enabled must retain its broad exception-handling and silent-False posture to degrade gracefully.
The guard is applied unevenly: test.yml:174,176 invoke check_readme_quickstart.py and probe_rebar.py without guards while gerrit-verify.yaml:324,333 guard the same scripts.

Four sites carry skip-side effects (mutation.yml writes matrix output, _optionality.yml has independent guards, _build-and-test.yml uses inverted form, _build-and-test.yml guards data file before sort -V) that cannot be replaced by a composite action.

Every gate step must either carry an -f guard for the file it needs or a # predates-gate-ok: comment with mandatory non-empty reason; every guarded step body must exit 0 with the canonical message when run in an empty directory.
